title: George W. Bush: Wartime President
credits: Kelly Jean Kelly wrote this report for Learning English. Hai Do was the editor.

sentences.en: VOA Learning English presents America’s Presidents.
sentences.zh: 美国之音英语学习节目为您带来《美国总统》系列。

sentences.en: Today we are talking about George Walker Bush.
sentences.zh: 今天我们来聊聊乔治·沃克·布什。

sentences.en: He took office in 2001 as the 43rd president.
sentences.zh: 他于2001年就职，成为第43任总统。

sentences.en: He has a similar name to another president -- his father, George Herbert Walker Bush.
sentences.zh: 他和另一位总统同名——他的父亲乔治·赫伯特·沃克·布什。

sentences.en: To simplify things, Americans sometimes call the younger Bush “43,” or simply “W.”
sentences.zh: 为了简便起见，美国人有时把小布什称为“43”，或直接称“W”。

sentences.en: Here we will just call him Bush.
sentences.zh: 在这里，我们就直接称他为布什。

sentences.en: Because Bush is a recent president, historians have not reached a broad agreement on his time as a leader.
sentences.zh: 由于布什是近几任总统，历史学家尚未对他的执政时期形成广泛共识。

sentences.en: But he will surely be remembered for facing one of the biggest challenges to any president: the attacks against the U.S. on September 11, 2001.
sentences.zh: 但他无疑会被铭记，因为他面临着任何一位总统都遭遇的最大挑战之一：2001年9月11日美国所遭受的袭击。

sentences.en: George Bush was born in the northeast state of Connecticut.
sentences.zh: 乔治·布什出生于东北部的康涅狄格州。

sentences.en: But his parents soon moved to the southwest state of Texas.
sentences.zh: 但他的父母很快搬到了西南部的得克萨斯州。

sentences.en: George grew up there and considered Texas home.
sentences.zh: 乔治在那里长大，并把得克萨斯州视为自己的家乡。

sentences.en: The Bush family had a long background in politics.
sentences.zh: 布什家族在政治领域有着悠久的背景。

sentences.en: Bush’s grandfather was a senator.
sentences.zh: 布什的祖父曾担任参议员。

sentences.en: His father held many public offices.
sentences.zh: 他的父亲担任过多个公职。

sentences.en: In some ways, George was prepared for a career in politics, too.
sentences.zh: 在某些方面，乔治也为从事政治生涯做好了准备。

sentences.en: He went to the same private boarding school as his father.
sentences.zh: 他就读于与父亲相同的私立寄宿学校。

sentences.en: Then, like his father and grandfather, George went to Yale for college.
sentences.zh: 随后，像他的父亲和祖父一样，乔治进入耶鲁大学读大学。

sentences.en: He also worked on several political campaigns.
sentences.zh: 他还参与了几场政治竞选活动。

sentences.en: But he said he did not consider pursuing politics.
sentences.zh: 但他说自己并未考虑从政。

sentences.en: Instead, he earned a degree in business at Harvard and took a job in an oil company in Texas.
sentences.zh: 相反，他在哈佛大学获得了商业学位，并在得克萨斯州的一家石油公司找到了一份工作。

sentences.en: In time, he founded his own oil business.
sentences.zh: 后来，他创办了自己的石油公司。

sentences.en: And he married Laura Welch, who was a teacher and librarian in their hometown.
sentences.zh: 他与劳拉·韦尔奇结婚，她曾是家乡的一名教师和图书管理员。

sentences.en: They had twin daughters named Barbara and Jenna.
sentences.zh: 他们生下了一对双胞胎女儿，分别叫芭芭拉和珍娜。

sentences.en: In these years as a young adult, Bush began to make some changes.
sentences.zh: 在作为年轻人的这些年里，布什开始做出一些改变。

sentences.en: He began attending a Christian church regularly.
sentences.zh: 他开始有规律地参加基督教教堂的活动。

sentences.en: He decided to stop drinking alcohol because it was creating problems in his personal life.
sentences.zh: 他决定戒酒，因为饮酒给他的个人生活带来了麻烦。

sentences.en: And he turned his attention to politics.
sentences.zh: 随后，他把注意力转向了政治。

sentences.en: Bush lost the first election in which he competed, a race to become a member of Congress.
sentences.zh: 布什输掉了他参与竞选的第一次选举，那是一场角逐国会席位的竞选。

sentences.en: So, for a while, he focused on business investments and helping his father’s political career.
sentences.zh: 因此，有一段时间，他专注于商业投资，并帮助父亲的政治生涯。

sentences.en: But in 1992, his father lost re-election to the presidency.
sentences.zh: 但在1992年，他父亲在总统连任竞选中落败。

sentences.en: And the younger Bush saw a chance to enter politics himself again.
sentences.zh: 而小布什则看到了再次从政的机会。

sentences.en: In 1994, Bush ran for governor of Texas.
sentences.zh: 1994年，布什竞选得克萨斯州州长。

sentences.en: To many people’s surprise, he won.
sentences.zh: 令许多人惊讶的是，他获胜了。

sentences.en: Four years later, he was overwhelmingly re-elected.
sentences.zh: 四年后，他以压倒性优势再次连任。

sentences.en: Many voters liked his image as, what he called, a “compassionate conservative.”
sentences.zh: 许多选民喜欢他自称为“富有同情心的保守派”的形象。

sentences.en: In other words, he wanted to use traditional Republican ideas about government to help society.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，他想用共和党关于政府的传统理念来促进社会的发展。

sentences.en: Following two successful terms as governor, Bush turned his attention to the presidency.
sentences.zh: 在成功连任两届州长之后，布什把注意力转向了总统之位。

sentences.en: In 2000, he competed against the vice president at the time, Al Gore.
sentences.zh: 2000年，他与当时的副总统阿尔·戈尔展开竞争。

sentences.en: The winner was not announced until more than a month following the election – usually, the winner is announced within hours.
sentences.zh: 直到选举结束一个多月后，获胜者才宣布——通常，获胜者会在几小时内宣布。

sentences.en: Both sides disputed the process of counting votes in the state of Florida.
sentences.zh: 双方都质疑佛罗里达州计票过程的公正性。

sentences.en: Finally, the U.S. Supreme Court ruled on the process.
sentences.zh: 最后，美国最高法院对选举程序作出了裁决。

sentences.en: The Court ordered state officials to stop re-counting votes.
sentences.zh: 法院命令州官员停止重新计票。

sentences.en: Bush’s lead stood.
sentences.zh: 布什的领先优势得以维持。

sentences.en: Bush entered office expecting to bring many of the ideas he pursued in Texas to the entire nation.
sentences.zh: 布什上任时，期望把他得克萨斯州推行的许多理念推广到全国。

sentences.en: For example, as president he permitted religious groups to receive government funding, and set national standards for public schools.
sentences.zh: 例如，就任总统后，他允许宗教团体获得政府资助，并为公立学校制定了国家标准。

sentences.en: These moves were popular with many voters.
sentences.zh: 这些举措受到许多选民欢迎。

sentences.en: But they also challenged some American traditions: the separation of church and state, and the ability of public schools to govern themselves.
sentences.zh: 但同时也挑战了一些美国传统：政教分离，以及公立学校自主管理的权利。

sentences.en: For many presidents, these policies might have created a legacy.
sentences.zh: 对许多总统而言，这些政策或许能留下历史遗产。

sentences.en: But early in Bush’s term, he faced a crisis that defined much of his time in office.
sentences.zh: 但在布什任期的早期，他就面临一场危机，这场危机定义了他执政的大部分时光。

sentences.en: Hijackers linked to the al-Qaeda group seized four airplanes on September 11, 2001.
sentences.zh: 与基地组织有关联的劫机者于2001年9月11日劫持了四架飞机。

sentences.en: They purposely crashed two planes into the twin towers of the World Trade Center in New York City, eventually killing more than 2,700 people.
sentences.zh: 他们故意让两架飞机撞向纽约世界贸易中心的双子塔，最终造成2700多人死亡。

sentences.en: Another plane was flown into the Pentagon, the country’s military headquarters outside of Washington, DC.
sentences.zh: 另一架飞机被撞向五角大楼，即华盛顿特区外的美国军事总部。

sentences.en: About 200 people died there.
sentences.zh: 约有200人在此遇难。

sentences.en: The fourth plane was aimed at another important target.
sentences.zh: 第四架飞机瞄准了另一个重要目标。

sentences.en: But passengers fought the hijackers.
sentences.zh: 但乘客与劫机者展开了搏斗。

sentences.en: The plane lost control and crashed in a field in Pennsylvania.
sentences.zh: 飞机失去控制，最终坠落在宾夕法尼亚州的一处田野。

sentences.en: All 44 people on board died there.
sentences.zh: 机上44人全部遇难。

sentences.en: President Bush was visiting an elementary school in Florida that morning.
sentences.zh: 那天清晨，布什正在佛罗里达州一所小学参观。

sentences.en: He learned about the attacks while he was reading with the children.
sentences.zh: 他在和孩子们一起读书时得知了这次袭击事件。

sentences.en: ​At the end of the day, Bush spoke to the nation.
sentences.zh: 在这一天结束时，布什向全国发表了讲话。

sentences.en: He said the U.S. would answer both the terrorist groups and the countries that permitted terrorist groups to thrive.
sentences.zh: 他表示，美国将同时回应恐怖组织以及允许恐怖组织滋生的国家。

sentences.en: Over the next years, Bush took a number of actions to create a new national security strategy.
sentences.zh: 在随后的几年里，布什采取了一系列行动，以建立新的国家安全战略。

sentences.en: They included creating a Department of Homeland Security, making changes to the country’s intelligence operations, and reforming the U.S. military.
sentences.zh: 这些措施包括成立国土安全部，对国家情报活动进行调整，以及改革美军。

sentences.en: He also sent U.S. forces into Afghanistan to destroy terrorist networks there.
sentences.zh: 他还派遣美军进入阿富汗，以摧毁当地的恐怖网络。

sentences.en: Bush was especially targeting the person who had designed the September 11 terrorist attacks, Osama bin Laden.
sentences.zh: 布什尤其将目标对准了策划“9·11”恐怖袭击的 Osama bin Laden。

sentences.en: The struggle in Afghanistan was successful at first, but continued throughout Bush’s time in office.
sentences.zh: 阿富汗的斗争起初取得了成功，但贯穿了布什的整个任期。

sentences.en: And bin Laden was not captured while Bush was president.
sentences.zh: 而在布什担任总统期间，本·拉登并未被抓获。

sentences.en: In 2003, Bush opened another front on what some called the “war on terror.”
sentences.zh: 2003年，布什在所谓“反恐战争”中又开辟了新战线。

sentences.en: He and other government officials said the leader of Iraq, Saddam Hussein, was developing weapons that could kill many people.
sentences.zh: 他和其它政府官员称，伊拉克领导人萨达姆·侯赛因正在研发能够杀伤大量人员的武器。

sentences.en: They said Hussein – and his connections to terrorist groups – threatened Americans and people in other countries.
sentences.zh: 他们称，侯赛因——以及他与恐怖组织的联系——对美国人和其它国家的人们构成了威胁。

sentences.en: Hussein did not agree to leave Iraq.
sentences.zh: 侯赛因并未同意离开伊拉克。

sentences.en: So U.S. and British forces launched bombs at targets in the country’s capital.
sentences.zh: 于是美国和英国军队对该国首都的目标发动了轰炸。

sentences.en: Additional troops destroyed what was left of the targets.
sentences.zh: 增援部队摧毁了目标所剩的残骸。

sentences.en: Hussein was quickly overthrown.
sentences.zh: 侯赛因很快被推翻。

sentences.en: But the weapons of mass destruction were not found.
sentences.zh: 然而，大规模杀伤性武器并未被找到。

sentences.en: For the rest of Bush’s presidency, U.S. forces remained in Iraq.
sentences.zh: 在布什总统任期的其余时间里，美军仍留在伊拉克。

sentences.en: Bush promised that Americans would stabilize the country and help Iraqis create a democratic government.
sentences.zh: 布什承诺，美国人将稳定该国局势，并帮助伊拉克人建立民主政府。

sentences.en: The presidency of George W.
sentences.zh: 乔治·W·布什的总统任期

sentences.en: Bush is too recent to understand its impact.
sentences.zh: 距今尚近，其影响尚难以完全理解。

sentences.en: But there is some evidence of the public’s reaction at the time.
sentences.zh: 但有一些证据表明了当时公众的反应。

sentences.en: Bush received some of the highest ratings of any president.
sentences.zh: 布什获得了历任总统中最高的评价之一。

sentences.en: In the weeks following the September 11 attacks, 90 percent approved of his leadership.
sentences.zh: 在9月11日袭击事件发生后的数周里，90%的人对他的表示认可。

sentences.en: He was re-elected in 2004.
sentences.zh: 他在2004年连任。

sentences.en: But his popularity steadily decreased .
sentences.zh: 但他的支持率却持续下降。

sentences.en: At the end of his second term, he had one of the lowest public approval ratings of any president: 33 percent.
sentences.zh: 在第二个任期结束时，他的公众支持率降至历任总统最低水平之一：仅为33%。

sentences.en: The U.S. economy had entered a recession.
sentences.zh: 美国经济已进入衰退期。

sentences.en: More Americans disagreed especially with his decision to invade Iraq.
sentences.zh: 更多美国人，尤其是反对他入侵伊拉克的决定。

sentences.en: And some criticized his government for responding too slowly after Hurricane Katrina struck New Orleans and the country’s Gulf Coast.
sentences.zh: 一些人对他在卡特里娜飓风袭击新奥尔良及该国墨西哥湾沿岸后政府反应过于迟缓提出批评。

sentences.en: Since Bush left the White House in 2009, his approval ratings have – like those of many presidents – risen again.
sentences.zh: 自布什2009年离开白宫以来，他的支持率已——如同许多总统那样——再度上升。

sentences.en: He has mostly avoided public appearances.
sentences.zh: 他大多回避公开露面。

sentences.en: Instead, he has enjoyed playing sports, helping charities, and reading U.S. history.
sentences.zh: 相反，他热衷于参与体育运动、从事慈善事业以及阅读美国历史。

sentences.en: He also began a new hobby: painting.
sentences.zh: 他还开始了一项新的爱好：绘画。

sentences.en: He has created portraits of dozens of veterans to honor their service in the military.
sentences.zh: 他为数十名退伍军人绘制了肖像，以表彰他们在军队中的服役。

sentences.en: I’m Kelly Jean Kelly.
sentences.zh: 我是凯莉·简·凯利。
